description: This file defines a TreeWalk class for traversing Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) with customizable pre- and post-processing methods, and a MetaFlatten metaclass to flatten class hierarchies.

classes.name: MetaFlatten
classes.description: A metaclass used to flatten class hierarchies for easier attribute manipulation.

classes.name: TreeWalk
classes.description: A class for traversing ASTs with support for recursive and non-recursive modes, customizable hooks, and node replacement.

methods.name: MetaFlatten.__new__
methods.description: Creates a new class with flattened base classes.

methods.name: TreeWalk.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the TreeWalk instance, optionally walking a given node.

methods.name: TreeWalk.setup
methods.description: Sets up pre- and post-handler dictionaries based on class methods.

methods.name: TreeWalk.walk
methods.description: Traverses the AST starting from a node, calling pre- and post-handler methods.

methods.name: TreeWalk.parent
methods.description: Returns the parent node of the current node.

methods.name: TreeWalk.parent_name
methods.description: Returns the parent node and the name of the current node.

methods.name: TreeWalk.replace
methods.description: Replaces the current node with a new node, maintaining tree integrity.
